h1: The 7 Best Cordless Chainsaws Under $100 for Light Yard Duty, Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: 7 cordless chainsaws under $100, all compact 6 to 8 inch saws, compared on batteries, brushless motors and oiling.
summary: The 1000W brushless 8 inch and 6 inch kit is the best cordless chainsaw under $100 for sheer specification, with two batteries and a stated brushless motor. The SEESII 8 Inch and 6 Inch kit adds an auto oiler, the SEESII Flagship 8-Inch is the step-up brushless model, and the Greenworks 24V 6in is the branded choice.
intro: Anyone who types cordless chainsaw into a store search and filters under $100 should understand what that budget buys: a handheld pruning saw, not a miniature of a gas chainsaw. Every product here has a 6 or 8 inch bar. They shine on branches, shrubs and small logs, and they struggle on anything much thicker than a forearm. Knowing that up front saves money and avoids disappointment.

With that framing, this ranking sorts seven compact saws by the things that separate them in the garden: whether the motor is brushless, how many batteries come in the box, whether the chain oils itself and who stands behind the tool. We reviewed the listings and specifications provided, and a Greenworks 10 inch saw was left out because its price tier sits above $100.

products.name: Mini Chainsaw Cordless, 8 Inch & 6 Inch Electric Chainsaw Battery Powered, 1000W Brushless Handheld Power Chain Saw with 2 Batteries
products.verdict: Two bars, two batteries and a stated 1000W brushless motor for $25 to $50.
products.description:
This kit pairs a 1000W brushless motor with 8 inch and 6 inch bar options and two batteries, marketed as a small tree saw for branch trimming and wood cutting. Listed range: $25 to $50.

It leads because it is the only kit here that states both a brushless motor and a wattage, and it hands you a spare battery. In a pruning saw the motor type is the best predictor of runtime. A brushless design wastes less current as heat, which stretches a small pack across more cuts. What holds it back from a perfect score is that the listing never mentions an oiler, so plan on oiling the chain by hand.

Buy it for pruning, small logs and general yard cleanup. Skip it if automatic oiling is a must-have.
pros: Two bar sizes in one kit
products.idealFor: Value hunters who want the most stated hardware.
products.skipIf: You need an oiler that works automatically.

products.name: SEESII 8 Inch & 6 Inch Mini Chainsaw Cordless with 2 Batteries & Auto Oiler
products.verdict: The same two-battery, two-bar idea as the leader, with an auto oiler added.
products.description:
SEESII's kit includes 8 inch and 6 inch bars, two batteries and an auto oiler. Listed range: $25 to $50.

It places second because the oiler is the practical feature that protects the chain. A dry chain on a small saw heats up, blunts and may jump off the bar, and automatic oiling keeps that from happening when you forget. What it lacks against the leader is any statement about the motor, so you do not know whether it is brushless. That is a fair swap if you hate stopping to oil.

Choose it if you want the safest and simplest routine. Skip it if motor efficiency matters more.
products.idealFor: Forgetful owners who want the chain looked after.
products.skipIf: You want a confirmed brushless motor.

products.name: SEESII Flagship 8-Inch Cordless Mini Chainsaw, Upgraded Brushless Motor
products.verdict: SEESII's upgraded brushless 8-inch saw, for those willing to spend up to $100.
products.description:
The Flagship has a single 8 inch bar and an upgraded brushless motor. Listed range: $50 to $100.

It takes third because paying up to double the price of the kits above buys a more refined machine on paper, not more accessories. The listing gives no battery count or oiler detail, and the cheaper kits include a spare pack. Still, a dedicated 8 inch brushless saw is a tidy single-purpose tool, and it reaches thicker limbs than a 6 inch.

Buy it if you plan regular use and want something sturdier than the entry kits. Skip it if you want the maximum number of items in the box.
products.idealFor: Frequent pruners wanting a dedicated 8 inch saw.
products.skipIf: You prefer a spare battery in the box.

products.name: Seesii Mini Chainsaw, 6-inch Mini Chainsaw Cordless, Handheld Electric Power Chain Saw with 2 Batteries
products.verdict: A 6 inch handheld saw with two batteries, listed for tree trimming and wood cutting.
products.description:
This 6 inch handheld electric saw includes two batteries and is aimed at trimming and cutting wood. Listed range: $25 to $50.

It lands fourth as the simplest option: one bar, a spare battery and no extras to learn. Against the leaders, you lose the second bar, any oiler mention and any motor detail. What you keep is a small, light saw that is easy to control with one hand when trimming thin branches.

Buy it as a low-risk first saw or a gift. Skip it if you want more cutting length.

products.name: Greenworks 24V 6in Mini Chainsaw, 2.0 Ah Battery and Charger
products.verdict: Greenworks quality control on a light 6 inch pruner, battery and charger supplied.
products.description:
The Greenworks has a 6 inch bar on the 24V platform, with a 2.0 Ah battery and charger included. Listed range: $50 to $100.

It ranks fifth because you pay more for less hardware: one battery and a short bar. The reasons to choose it are non-technical. Greenworks has a recognisable warranty route, replacement parts and a wider 24V tool range, so the battery can run other tools you add later.

Buy it if you prefer a mainstream brand and may expand your tool collection. Skip it if raw value is the priority.
products.idealFor: Buyers who like a recognised brand.
products.skipIf: You want maximum kit for the money.

products.name: SEESII 6-Inch Mini Chainsaw Cordless with Oiler System
products.verdict: A 6 inch SEESII with an oiler system, but priced above the richer kits.
products.description:
This SEESII saw has a 6 inch bar and an oiler system. Listed range: $50 to $100.

It ranks sixth because the oiler is its only highlight, and the cheaper SEESII kit with two batteries and a second bar includes an oiler as well. The listing gives no motor or battery information, so the higher range is hard to justify.

Buy it only if this specific design suits you. Skip it if you want value, because $25 to $50 kits cover more.
products.idealFor: SEESII fans wanting a 6 inch oiled model.

products.name: SEESII 6 Inch Mini Electric Chainsaw Cordless Battery Powered
products.verdict: A bare-bones 6 inch SEESII saw with almost no detail in the listing.
products.description:
This is a 6 inch battery-powered mini chainsaw from SEESII. Listed range: $25 to $50.

It ranks last because the listing offers no further information, including battery count, motor type or oiling. Without those facts it is impossible to put it above any kit that names its contents. At this price you may still get a working pruning saw, but you are buying on trust.

Buy it only if the price is right and you accept the unknowns. Skip it if you want documented features.

whatMatters.factor: What a sub-$100 saw can cut
whatMatters.detail: A 6 inch bar cuts wood up to roughly 5 inches across in practice, and an 8 inch bar slightly more. They are pruners. Check the bar length on the listing and compare it with your thickest branch before buying.

A brushless motor uses electronic control, so it runs cooler and uses less battery. That means more cuts per charge and longer tool life. If the listing does not mention brushless, assume a brushed motor and shorter runtime.
Runtime on a small pack is measured in minutes, not hours. A second battery lets you charge one while you cut with the other. Look for two batteries in the title or the bullet list.
A chain without oil overheats and wears quickly. Auto oilers do the job as you cut, whereas manual oiling relies on you remembering. Keep bar and chain oil on hand either way.
Even compact saws can kick back if the tip of the bar touches wood. Use both hands, wear gloves and eye protection, and avoid cutting above shoulder height. Read the safety section of the manual.

cards.label: Look for
cards.text: A complete kit with batteries, a charger and a clear manual. The recipient should be able to start cutting after a short charge.

cards.label: In this ranking
cards.text: The 1000W brushless kit and the Seesii 6-inch with 2 batteries are complete boxes at low prices. The Greenworks 6in is the brand-name option.

cards.label: Spend more if
cards.text: You cut regularly or want a motor you can trust for years. The SEESII Flagship 8-Inch or the Greenworks 24V is worth the premium.

cards.label: Save if
cards.text: You prune lightly a few times a year. The 1000W kit at $25 to $50 does the job.

faq.a: They can cut small logs and branches, but they are not firewood machines. Anything much thicker than the bar length is better handled by a full-size saw.

faq.q: What is the most common mistake with cheap cordless saws?
faq.a: Running them without enough bar oil. A dry chain overheats quickly and can wear the bar out, so top up the reservoir before every session even when an auto oiler is fitted.

faq.q: Is the Greenworks 24V worth it over a SEESII kit?
faq.a: If you value warranty and a larger tool range, yes. If you want two batteries and an oiler for less, the SEESII kits are better value.
Usually 10 minutes. Fit the bar and chain, set tension, fill the oil reservoir and charge a battery. Check the chain direction before you start.
Clean sawdust from the bar groove, keep the chain tight and oiled, and store batteries partly charged in a cool place. Replace a blunt chain rather than forcing the cut.

faq.q: Can I use it with one hand?
faq.a: Some listings call these handheld, but two hands give far better control and reduce kickback risk. Reserve one-hand use for thin branches you can support.

finalTake: The 1000W brushless kit is the best cordless chainsaw under $100 on paper, with two batteries, two bars and a stated brushless motor. The SEESII 8 Inch and 6 Inch kit adds an auto oiler, and the SEESII Flagship 8-Inch is the better single saw. The Greenworks 24V suits those who want a familiar brand. Remember that all of these are compact pruning saws.
